usage: dispat diagnostics <message> [flags]

Parse exactly one commit message and report every warning and error.
The message is used exactly as supplied, including an empty string or embedded
newlines. Warnings exit 0; parser errors exit 1.

Without --config, the CCME parser defaults are used and no repository is
searched. An explicit --config loads that file and its references, relative to
--root, but does not require Git or scan manifests. --log-format json emits one
JSON event per diagnostic.

global flags:
      --concurrency ints       override the configured concurrency: one value for both stages, or build,publish (e.g. 4,2); dispat run uses the build value
      --config string          config file name, relative to --root; when not set, the first of dispat.json, dispat.yaml, dispat.yml, dispat.toml that exists (default "dispat.json")
      --env-file stringArray   read environment variables from this file instead of ./.env (repeatable, later files win); variables the environment already sets are kept
  -h, --help                   print help for the command and exit
      --log-format string      override the configured logFormat (pretty, json)
      --log-level string       override the configured logLevel (trace, debug, info, warn, error)
      --quiet-parser           hide the commit-message parser's diagnostics; --quiet-parser=false shows them again when parser.quiet is set
      --root string            monorepo root folder (default ".")
      --version                print the dispat version and exit
